Critical checks before the burn: correlate high-rate B-side 28V voltage, B-side regulator state bits, bus current, individual heater currents, and A-side bus channels at ~100 ms resolution to verify timing/causality; inspect regulator/PMU event logs, MOSFET temperatures and switching telemetry, and battery charge/discharge current; and run an automated historical search for similar sub-10s sags. Decision rule: if checks confirm a single heater-driven transient with no regulator fault flags and A-side unaffected, proceed after validating burn power margins; if regulator hardware faults, repeatable sags, or abnormal MOSFET temps are found, defer the burn and escalate to power hardware troubleshooting. I will begin the timeline correlation and pattern search now and deliver a prioritized checklist and a 60–90 minute status update; please hold final burn authorization until those cross-checks complete.
